item.title: Free agent guard Marcus Smart has agreed to a two-year, $21M deal…
item.description: Free agent guard Marcus Smart has agreed to a two-year, $21 million deal with the Los Angeles Lakers, sources tell ESPN. Smart had offers from multiple contenders but chose Los Angeles. #LakeShow
